content.short: Decibel is a high-performance central limit order book (CLOB) DEX on the Aptos network featuring unified margin.
content.description: Decibel is a decentralized derivatives and spot exchange built natively on the Aptos blockchain, designed to offer a professional trading experience with sub-second finality. Utilizing a high-throughput central limit order book (CLOB) architecture, the platform supports complex trading strategies and provides a unified margin system to maximize capital efficiency for its users. By leveraging the Move language and Aptos's parallel execution, Decibel delivers the speed and liquidity required for institutional-grade decentralized trading while maintaining the core principles of non-custodial security and transparency.
content.meta: Decibel provides professional-grade CLOB trading and unified margin on Aptos. Discover Decibel and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
